method: exact static Docker/source/lock/caller inspection with SHA256; no build/download/install/runtime execution

records.excerpt:
# Version defaults are generated from versions.json; run npm run versions:sync.
ARG BUILDKIT_BASE=moby/buildkit:v0.26.2-rootless@sha256:0ffa2fcf6b8757c47d569b3ef0f03f9d5eb3b9ff5ce68d858f994f89b749da0c
ARG BUSTER_NODE_BASE=node:24-bookworm-slim@sha256:ba849c60be29959425b8734d57b8b4b7d56f98edd9504c9af091d5281095a71e

# Buster's v2 suite worker and colocated rootless image builder.
FROM ${BUILDKIT_BASE} AS buildkit
FROM ${BUSTER_NODE_BASE}

USER root
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
ARG DEBIAN_SNAPSHOT=20260713T000000Z
ARG TARGETARCH
ARG KUBECLAW_BUILD_REVISION=unknown
ARG KUBECTL_VERSION=1.35.6
ARG KUBECTL_SHA256_AMD64=5d11e2ba01ea68ffd053f56e27738e2b4330013ee67f7e46c6da6c585d3c9926
ARG KUBECTL_SHA256_ARM64=c0f97f31c9ddc22d4951d543a1a7125a9af4b31e895ad4aa99899c4ba2a6ff0b
ARG TRIVY_VERSION=0.74.0
ARG TRIVY_SHA256_AMD64=2ae6fe3ee734b7fdf11335663e18c75ea12dccc76062f09f164a3b0f8be4371a
ARG TRIVY_SHA256_ARM64=b94ce1976bbf3c15b514b605ee88be7c6d94a29be2302847ff01cb794d47aad5

# The dated Debian snapshot pins the complete dependency graph coherently.
# hadolint ignore=DL3008
RUN printf '%s\n' \
      'Types: deb' \
      "URIs: https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/${DEBIAN_SNAPSHOT}" \
      'Suites: bookworm bookworm-updates' \
      'Components: main' \
      'Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg' \
      '' \
      'Types: deb' \
      "URIs: https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian-security/${DEBIAN_SNAPSHOT}" \
      'Suites: bookworm-security' \
      'Components: main' \
      'Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg' \
      > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources \
    && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list \
    && printf 'Acquire::Check-Valid-Until "false";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99snapshot \
    && packages=(bash ca-certificates curl git openssh-client jq python3 python3-pip uidmap libcap2-bin fuse-overlayfs iproute2 iptables tini util-linux build-essential shellcheck yamllint ripgrep tree netcat-openbsd nmap) \
    && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update \
    && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y --no-install-recommends "${packages[@]}" \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && chmod 0755 /usr/bin/newuidmap /usr/bin/newgidmap \
    && setcap cap_setuid=ep /usr/bin/newuidmap \
    && setcap cap_setgid=ep /usr/bin/newgidmap

COPY --from=buildkit /usr/bin/buildkitd /usr/local/bin/buildkitd
COPY --from=buildkit /usr/bin/buildctl /usr/local/bin/buildctl
COPY --from=buildkit /usr/bin/buildkit-runc /usr/local/bin/buildkit-runc
COPY --from=buildkit /usr/bin/rootlesskit /usr/local/bin/rootlesskit

RUN set -eux; \
    arch="${TARGETARCH:-amd64}"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) kubectl_sha="$KUBECTL_SHA256_AMD64"; trivy_arch=64bit; trivy_sha="$TRIVY_SHA256_AMD64" ;; \
      arm64) kubectl_sha="$KUBECTL_SHA256_ARM64"; trivy_arch=ARM64; trivy_sha="$TRIVY_SHA256_ARM64" ;; \
      *) exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    curl -fsSL "https://dl.k8s.io/release/v${KUBECTL_VERSION}/bin/linux/${arch}/kubectl" -o /tmp/kubectl; \
    printf '%s  %s\n' "$kubectl_sha" /tmp/kubectl | sha256sum -c -; \
    install -m 0755 /tmp/kubectl /usr/local/bin/kubectl; \
    trivy_archive="trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-${trivy_arch}.tar.gz"; \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/${trivy_archive}" -o "/tmp/${trivy_archive}"; \
    printf '%s  %s\n' "$trivy_sha" "/tmp/${trivy_archive}" | sha256sum -c -; \

ARG RUFF_VERSION=0.15.22
ARG MYPY_VERSION=2.3.0
ARG PIP_AUDIT_VERSION=2.10.1
ARG SEMGREP_VERSION=1.170.1
COPY docker/python-tools/buster.txt /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt
RUN grep -F "ruff==${RUFF_VERSION} " /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt \
    && grep -F "mypy==${MYPY_VERSION} " /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt \
    && grep -F "pip-audit==${PIP_AUDIT_VERSION} " /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt \
    && grep -F "semgrep==${SEMGREP_VERSION} " /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt \
    && pip install --break-system-packages --no-cache-dir --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: \
      -r /opt/kubeclaw-python-locks/buster.txt

ENV PATH="/app/node_modules/.bin:${PATH}" \
    PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright \
    KUBECLAW_BUILD_REVISION=${KUBECLAW_BUILD_REVISION}

COPY package.json package-lock.json /app/
COPY contracts /app/contracts
# This copy is the production provider payload. The runtime discovers every
# role-approved provider below /app/skills/buster/plugins, including Axe.
COPY skills /app/skills
COPY charts/kubeclaw/files/config/swarm.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/prism-control.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/prism-studio.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/prism-worker.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/prism-execution.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/buster-engine.config.json charts/kubeclaw/files/config/worker-core.config.json /etc/kubeclaw/swarm/
COPY scripts/build-plugin-sandbox.mjs /app/scripts/build-plugin-sandbox.mjs

caseLimit: Docker absent/current context omissions remain explicit, not structural image-build PASS
